people.name: Gerizim_Mount
people.line: Mountain in Samaria; site of blessings and Jotham's parable

people.name: Jotham
people.line: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
translations.bsb: When this was reported to Jotham, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, and cried out: “Listen to me, O leaders of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
translations.kjv: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken
translations.asv: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
